See [Before merge](#before-merge). | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Security review found an item that needs attention. | ## Product **Kind:** Refactor · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Synchronous session reads occupy the Gateway thread, and completion actions can reject their own successfully updated source. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored change follows the established worker migration direction and records the accepted preparation and post-success tradeoffs. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 3 items remain** Keep this maintainer-authored PR open: it completes a useful worker cutover, and no concrete introduced defect was established in the inspected paths. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `1aec560dd3ecc1e59368e85a550df7c539df58ef` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add real behavior proof** - Authority-chain proof required: the reported live Gateway workload exercises ordinary turns at 22bf8aa966027a499abbeb784f6e2aab9e44a397, before later authority repairs. Provide redacted logs or terminal output showing allowed execution and refusal after policy revocation or conversation reassignment before native writes, permission replies, cancellation, recovered child receipt persistence, and queued replay, including changes during awaited preparation. Redact credentials, IP addresses, phone numbers, and non-public endpoints. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. - [ ] **Resolve security concern: Validate authority after asynchronous preparation** - Prepared source authority reaches native writes, permission decisions, cancellation, and recovered delivery. The supplied ordinary-turn run predates later authority repairs and does not establish rejection of revoked or reassigned callers at these final effects. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk** - Before merge, establish that recovered source receipts and effect scopes cannot authorize native or cross-user effects after revocation or reassignment during awaited preparation. ## Findings - [medium] Validate authority after asynchronous preparation — `src/agents/agent-harness-completion-recovery.ts:477` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Missing final-effect traces covering the later authority repairs, with allowed execution and refusal of revoked or reassigned callers before I/O.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Session readers supply entry and conversation facts to Slack, Codex, and agent execution; writer transactions and effect adapters consume those facts alongside live caller authority. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Slack and Codex callers] --> B[Session reader worker] B --> C[Prepared session facts] C --> D[Live source authority] D --> E[Session writer transaction] D --> F[Effect adapter] F --> G[Native process or channel transport] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Complete the existing reader-worker cutover while preserving live final-effect authorization and the documented SDK compatibility window. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source shows synchronous entry and conversation reads in the retained currentness callback; no runtime reproduction was performed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Reusing the existing readers, writer predicates, and receipt authority is a coherent solution, with accepted preparation-only edge cases documented by the maintainer. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [2cddf96f6c97](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2cddf96f6c97c5a50b39b1cf4df867865c050abc). ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Prove final-effect authority (recommended)** Provide allowed and nearest-forbidden execution traces through the changed native and recovery boundaries, including revocation or reassignment during awaited preparation. ### Provenance checked - `Bundled currentness and SDK compatibility` keeps the original intent (ad3c93078e7fca4eb8733185479a627d5bea4988: Carry source predicates into worker transactions while preserving live host grants and released callback compatibility.) - `Completion recovery authority` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/147903: Recover admitted native completions after restart under exact requester and delivery custody; later refactors moved the owner out of Tasks.) - `Rejected queued handoffs` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/149370: Prevent rejected handoffs from becoming replayable while retaining ordinary transient retries.) - `Retained completion source lifetime` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (79e33e8471a5ffdb8cf5b6405d11097d4bf8b576: Retain inactive incognito source authority; this PR explains replacing the durable retained snapshot with fresh effect-scoped facts while keeping incognito custody.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security Needs attention: The changed authority chain needs final-effect validation; source inspection established no concrete bypass. ### Evidence Security concerns: - [medium] Validate authority after asynchronous preparation — `src/agents/agent-harness-completion-recovery.ts:477` Prepared source authority reaches native writes, permission decisions, cancellation, and recovered delivery. The supplied ordinary-turn run predates later authority repairs and does not establish rejection of revoked or reassigned callers at these final effects. ([`src/config/sessions/session-entry-current-check.ts:357`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1aec560dd3ecc1e59368e85a550df7c539df58ef/src/config/sessions/session-entry-current-check.ts#L357), [1aec560dd3ec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1aec560dd3ecc1e59368e85a550df7c539df58ef)) - **SDK compatibility retained:** The synchronous SDK method remains available with a warning and removal scheduled for the next SDK major; bundled production references use the asynchronous method. The maintainer-authored PR records this compatibility choice. ([`src/plugin-sdk/session-binding-runtime.ts:16`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1aec560dd3ecc1e59368e85a550df7c539df58ef/src/plugin-sdk/session-binding-runtime.ts#L16), [1aec560dd3ec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1aec560dd3ecc1e59368e85a550df7c539df58ef)) - **Currentness provenance:** The verified patch for commit ad3c930 introduced the currentness owner to carry source predicates into worker transactions while preserving live host grants and released callback compatibility. ([`src/config/sessions/session-entry-current-check.ts:103`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ad3c93078e7fca4eb8733185479a627d5bea4988/src/config/sessions/session-entry-current-check.ts#L103), [ad3c93078e7f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad3c93078e7fca4eb8733185479a627d5bea4988)) - **Completion authority:** Completion scopes prepare the existing requester receipt and compare its scoped write token at the external-effect callback; cross-store entry commits enter the same source scope. ([`src/agents/agent-harness-completion-recovery.ts:477`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1aec560dd3ecc1e59368e85a550df7c539df58ef/src/agents/agent-harness-completion-recovery.ts#L477), [1aec560dd3ec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1aec560dd3ecc1e59368e85a550df7c539df58ef)) - **Queued rejection intent preserved:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/149370 established permanent settlement of rejected handoffs while preserving transient retries; the changed adapter still runs its final authority assertion when asynchronous preparation fails. ([`src/infra/outbound/deliver-channel.ts:240`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/6cf521932af06af674a90e2319ccbd6212261e5d/src/infra/outbound/deliver-channel.ts#L240), [6cf521932af0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6cf521932af06af674a90e2319ccbd6212261e5d)) - **Supplied behavior evidence:** The complete PR body reports ordinary live Gateway turns, child completion, cron, compaction, and shutdown on 22bf8aa966027a499abbeb784f6e2aab9e44a397, and separately identifies later authority repairs.
